tools.name: calibration_generate
tools.title: Generate calibration print
tools.description: Generate a calibration test as the session project, using OrcaSlicer's built-in calibration modes. This replaces the currently open project. Types: 'flow_rate' (two-pass flow ratio patches), 'pressure_advance' (PA pattern/tower/line), 'temperature' (temp tower for the active filament), 'retraction' (retraction length tower), 'max_volumetric_speed' (flow ramp test). Uses the active printer/filament/process presets; open or select those first. The response includes the generated plate summary and the guide id (for guides_get) explaining how to read the printed result and which setting key to update with the outcome. This tool only exists because calibration generation is procedural; for open-ended tuning advice use guides_search instead.

params.description: Optional per-type overrides; server defaults match the OrcaSlicer calibration dialog.

start.description: Start value of the tested range (unit depends on type).

end.description: End value of the tested range.

variant.description: Sub-variant where the type has one, e.g. pressure_advance: 'pattern' | 'tower' | 'line'.
